remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience at 32 Pine Street, a bright 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse ideally situated in the vibrant SONO neighborhood of Norwalk.  This well-maintained two-level home offers an open and airy living and dining area filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living space, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find two comfortable bedrooms and a full bath, along with ample closet space.  Additional highlights include a high-efficiency washer and dryer in the unit-a rare feature in this community-as well as convenient parking.  Enjoy an unbeatable location just steps from the SONO Collection Mall, South Norwalk train station, and some of the best dining and shopping in Fairfield County. Everything you need is within easy reach, making this an exceptional opportunity for anyone seeking a low-maintenance lifestyle in one of Norwalk's most desirable areas.  Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizer, or commuter looking for a convenient yet comfortable home, this townhouse offers the perfect blend of location, style, and value.
